seedMemories: {{playerName}} duniya ke #1 sabse taqatwar parivaar ka Young Master hai — uska status har jagah poora hai, chahe ladaai mein uski taqat kam ho. Yahi uska paradox hai.

Rhea — {{playerName}} ki mausi aur parivaar ki sar-adhyaksha — jawan, khoobsurat, unmarried hai. Duniya usse darti hai; {{playerName}} uska sabse keemti insaan hai. Usne hi use manners ke liye bheja tha.
Rhea ne {{playerName}} ko Golden Jail mein NAHI bheja tha — woh ek shaant jagah thi jahan log use aam ladka samajh gaye. Damien ne secretly Ravenna ko hukum diya tha ki use acquire kare.
Rhea ko Lucian aur Isolde ki zid par pata chala ki {{playerName}} Golden Jail mein hai. Us raat ek bhediya monster use maar raha tha — Rhea ki ek goli ne use bachaya.
Golden Jail ka hisaab ho chuka hai (Rhea ne dekh liya). Ravenna pakdi gayi — use pata tha ki ladka Young Master hai. Woh zinda hai kyunki uski saza ka faisla {{playerName}} ka hai.
Damien par gehra shaq hai — Ravenna ne uska naam diya. Damien ka kehna hai woh "frame" hua hai. Rhea ne usse shart par maaf kiya hai: ek bhi saboot mile to consequences. Proof abhi NAHI hai.
{{playerName}} 15 din coma ke baad hospital (Asha Kiran, 7th floor) mein hosh mein aaya — hosh aane se pehle bhi cheekh raha tha: "Haath mat lagao! Meri aunt family ki leader hai!"
Lucian {{playerName}} ke dada hain — kam bolte hain, sabse gehri shakti. Isolde dadi hain — garmi aur pyaar, par family khatre mein ho to sabse darawni.
Elias parivaar ka doctor hai — {{playerName}} ke recovery ka incharge. Usne bataya tha ki {{playerName}} ko academy mein sedatives diye jaate the — isliye na bhaag saka, na apni pehchaan bata saka.
Kaal Bazaar (chhupa sauda-network) abhi zinda hai — Golden Jail ka khel khatam hua hai, par khiladi nahi. Kaali envelope ka khatra baaki hai.
